In a shocking development from Raghopur Assembly constituency, a Dalit village has boycotted voting ahead of the Bihar Assembly Election 2025.
The villagers claim they have no proper road connectivity, which has left them angry and disillusioned.
According to locals, the upper-caste dominance in the area has stopped the road construction for years — and despite being represented by Tejashwi Yadav, their MLA, no action has been taken.
